races.paceDynamic: Rahmi will likely set the pace from the front with minimal pressure early, as most runners prefer prominent or midfield positions rather than aggressive leading tactics. Fort Vega, Bella Isabella, and Key Witness will track closely in the second rank, creating a steady gallop through the first 4-5 furlongs. The large field of 17 runners means positioning will be crucial, with hold-up horses Sir Les Patterson and Go Athletico needing luck in running. This controlled early pace followed by a cavalry charge finish strongly favours prominent racers who can secure good positions and kick when the tempo lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Prominents
scenarios.trigger: If Rahmi sets steady fractions without early pressure from Fort Vega or Bella Isabella
scenarios.body: The race becomes a positioning battle with the tempo lifting only in the final 2f, allowing prominent runners to strike first. Quality horses like Key Witness and Fort Vega can utilise their class advantage when the race opens up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Fort Vega or City House challenge Rahmi early, creating faster fractions
scenarios.body: The increased early pace sets up a stronger finish, bringing hold-up horses into play while testing the stamina of early leaders. Sir Les Patterson and Go Athletico benefit from the collapse of pace-setters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Problems Decide
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates significant interference in the straight with runners bunching
scenarios.body: Lucky positioning becomes paramount over pure ability, favouring horses drawn well or those held up wide. Lower-rated runners like Bishopton or Bint Majestic Roi can capitalise on clear runs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Rahmi faces no early challenges and builds an unassailable lead
scenarios.body: The pace-setter gets an easy time of it and proves too strong when challenged, with second-rank prominent runners fighting for minor honours. Class tells when the race shape favours the leader.

watchPoints.text: Rahmi must be monitored for early pressure as any challenge could compromise his stamina reserves late

Traffic problems likely with 17 runners over 7f, watch for interference in straight affecting main contenders
Fort Vega's consistent recent form makes him clear danger if securing ideal prominent position
Sir Les Patterson and Go Athletico need strong early pace to bring their hold-up styles into play

races.paceDynamic: Khafar was designated as the likely front runner but has been withdrawn, leaving this race without a clear early leader. With 15 remaining runners all showing Hold-Up or Unknown styles except for no confirmed pace-setters, expect a messy early pace with reluctant leaders creating a falsely-run race. The lack of natural speed will likely result in a slowly-run affair that becomes a tactical sprint in the final 2f. This scenario strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can position close enough to strike, disadvantaging true hold-up performers who rely on strong early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If no horse commits to make the running early and the pace becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The race becomes a 2f dash where positioning and tactical speed matter more than stamina, suiting horses who can travel handily rather than from the rear. Those with recent promise over shorter distances or tactical pace will have clear advantages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If one of the unknown styles (Riot Star, Osterode) shows unexpected early pace
scenarios.body: A more genuine gallop develops allowing the proven hold-up performers to show their staying power over the trip. The race becomes more of a stamina test where horses with stronger recent form can capitalize.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses attempt to lead creating interference and uneven fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes scrappy with stop-start fractions that don't suit any running style particularly well. Form horses with experience in similar tactical battles and strong jockey bookings become crucial.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Strong Early Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If a trainer instructs their jockey to commit fully to making strong early running
scenarios.body: Unlikely but would create the most honest test where pure ability over the distance decides the outcome. Hold-up horses with the best fundamental form ratings would benefit most.

races.paceDynamic: Keke sits as the sole established pace-setter with solid recent form including a 5f victory, likely to control fractions without serious pressure from the gate. Erosandpsyche, Kendall Roy, Eclairage and Gazelle d'Or will settle prominently but none are confirmed speed horses to challenge Keke's early supremacy. The lack of genuine pace pressure means this sets up as a tactical affair with a strong gallop only materializing in the final two furlongs. This controlled tempo strongly favours hold-up horses like Oh Cecelia, Billie Be Quick, Fregada and Likedbymike who can unleash finishing kicks over the sharp 5f trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Keke Controls Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Keke gets an uncontested lead and dictates moderate fractions through halfway
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the closers to make up ground, allowing Keke to maintain his advantage and hold off late challengers. His recent 5f win proves he can sustain strong pace when in control.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady enough for closers to position perfectly and unleash trademark finishing kicks
scenarios.body: Oh Cecelia and Billie Be Quick get ideal trips tracking the moderate tempo before producing devastating late bursts. The 3yo allowance gives Oh Cecelia a crucial edge in a tight finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners press Keke early creating unsustainable fractions through the first three furlongs
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes too fierce with Erosandpsyche, Eclairage and Gazelle d'Or all fighting for position behind Keke. This sets up perfectly for the patient hold-up types to sweep past tired leaders.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Tactical Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the pace crawls through halfway before exploding into a sprint finish over the final furlong
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test where Gazelle d'Or's recent 6f form and tactical pace gives her the edge in a blanket finish. Eclairage also benefits from this scenario given his recent promising efforts.

watchPoints.text: Keke getting too soft a lead through the opening two furlongs which would make him very difficult to peg back
Oh Cecelia getting trapped behind horses in the straight given the small field and her need for racing room
Kendall Roy showing ring rust after the 115-day absence despite his previous winning form
Early positioning battle between the prominent types Erosandpsyche, Eclairage and Gazelle d'Or which could set up the race shape
How aggressively the hold-up horses Fregada and Likedbymike are ridden given the short 5f distance

races.paceDynamic: Cuban Grey and Sarahmae will set a reasonable early gallop with Fox In Flight, Treasured Royal, Nouvel Espoir and Happy Henry tracking just behind in the prominent positions. The pace should be honest but not frantic given the 5f sprint distance and lack of multiple confirmed front-runners pressuring each other. This moderate early tempo will allow the hold-up horses like Lamar Canyon, Genesis, Beauty Queen, Harry's Hill and Devil's Angel to get into contention turning for home. The race shape strongly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses who can benefit from the sustainable pace and finish strongly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Flourish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves genuine but not excessive, allowing closers time to wind up
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop will suit the patient tactics of horses held up early, giving them every chance to unleash their finishing kicks. Lamar Canyon's class edge and Genesis's proven 5f form make them prime beneficiaries of this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Pays
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters maintain their advantage and the closers fail to peg them back
scenarios.body: Happy Henry's recent winning form and Treasured Royal's consistent efforts suggest they can capitalize if the hold-up brigade doesn't quite get there in time. Fox In Flight's 5f experience also makes him dangerous if tracking the leaders pays off.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is particularly steady and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: A cavalry charge finish would emerge with multiple horses hitting the line together, favouring those with the strongest recent form regardless of early positioning. The consistent performers who've shown 5f ability recently would thrive in this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Cuban Grey and the early leaders go too fast and capitulate in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The most patient hold-up horses positioned at the back would have the freshest finish to pick up the pieces. Devil's Angel's long absence becomes less relevant if others tire dramatically ahead of him.

watchPoints.text: Cuban Grey could set unsustainable fractions if pressed early by Sarahmae, potentially setting up a pace collapse scenario
Lamar Canyon's 19-day break combined with hold-up tactics means he needs the race to unfold perfectly to utilize his class advantage
Happy Henry's recent consistency and featherweight suggests he could outrun his modest official rating if prominent tactics work
Devil's Angel's 257-day layoff makes him impossible to assess with confidence despite attractive conditions
Treasured Royal's headgear application suggests trainer expects improvement from this consistent three-year-old

races.paceDynamic: Sparan Nua will take them along at a sustainable gallop in this small field, with no other confirmed front-runners to apply early pressure. The prominent brigade of Nyra, Beset, Perfect Your Craft and Bloom will settle tracking within striking distance, while only Ice Dancer represents genuine hold-up tactics. With limited early pace and a small field, this sets up as a tactical affair that will likely develop into a sprint finish. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers who can position handy and quicken when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Sparan Nua maintains an even gallop and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical sprint where those best positioned in the leading group can unleash their turn of foot. Prominent racers with proven finishing kicks will have the edge over hold-up horses who may struggle to make up ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sparan Nua Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner's class advantage (OR 120) allows her to dictate and kick clear
scenarios.body: With no early pressure, Sparan Nua can control fractions and use her superior rating to pull away when challenged. Her unbeaten record and tactical speed make her hard to peg back if allowed an easy lead.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and the field comes back to the closers
scenarios.body: Ice Dancer's hold-up style finally pays dividends as the prominently-raced horses stop in front. A strong late run from the back can sweep up tiring leaders in a slowly-run affair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If the gallop becomes more genuine than expected with multiple horses pressing
scenarios.body: The race opens up for horses showing versatility in running style and current form. Those with tactical speed and fitness edges can capitalize when others falter.

watchPoints.text: Sparan Nua's early fractions - if she goes too fast early she may not last home despite her class advantage
Perfect Your Craft and Bloom both wearing headgear changes which could affect their settling patterns
Ice Dancer's positioning early - if she gets too far back in this small field she'll struggle to make up ground
Bosphorus Rose's fitness levels after 206 days off - any signs of ring-rustiness will end her chances quickly
The pace through the first half-mile - anything slower than steady will favor those with tactical speed

races.paceDynamic: Clonbun will take this field along from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters, creating a sustainable tempo that won't stretch the field. The prominent runner will dictate terms without pressure, allowing the large pack of hold-up horses to get into contention turning for home. With 12 of 14 runners employing hold-up tactics, the finish will become a cavalry charge as they all try to time their runs simultaneously. This race shape strongly favours the few horses that can race prominently early and avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably arise in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Clonbun Controls Uncontested
scenarios.trigger: If Clonbun gets an easy lead without early pressure from the field.
scenarios.body: Ben Coen can dictate his own fractions and kick clear when the hold-up brigade gets caught in traffic behind. The lone pace-setter will have first run on a field that needs to come from too far back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the dozen hold-up horses all arrive together in the final two furlongs.
scenarios.body: A wall of horses will fan across the track with several getting stopped for runs at crucial moments. The horse that gets the clearest passage through the melee will prevail over better horses caught behind traffic.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Clonbun gets joined by another horse racing handily in the early stages.
scenarios.body: Two horses clear of the pack will have the race between them as the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground. The tactical advantage of avoiding the scramble behind proves decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely collapses and becomes a sprint from the three-furlong pole.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure test of finishing speed where class tells and the best horse on ratings can overcome the tactical disadvantage. Superior ability trumps poor positioning in a slowly-run affair.

watchPoints.text: Clonbun must be watched for any early pressure as his uncontested lead is crucial to the race dynamic.
Traffic congestion in the home straight will be severe with 12 hold-up horses converging simultaneously.
Stella Amorosa and other faders may struggle more than usual in this large competitive field.
Cisterna's familiarity with course and distance could prove vital if she gets racing prominently early.
Jockey changes on several runners including apprentice Wesley Joyce taking over on Cause I Like You.
